headline:
Your insurer just moved
the roof clock from
[[20 years to 15]].
attribution: Roger Averbuj, Broker | Prestige Heritage Realty | (954) 663-8461
takeaway: A newer roof is now the fastest way to a better rate. An aging one is the fastest way to lose it.

stats.label: Insurers now flag asphalt and composition roofs at 15 years, not 20.
Metal roofs can still get favorable treatment from insurers up to 40 years.
One homeowner's annual premium, stuck there by a roof turning 15 this month.
